episodes.156460: On February 22nd and with the passage of a strong cold front, an afternoon of moderate rainfall brought 0.25 to 0.50 inches of precipitation to portions of Whitman County. The additional rain contributed to a culvert failure along State Route 23, south of Lamont.
episodes.157341: An active South Pacific Convergence Zone (SPCZ) over the islands developed strong winds and heavy rainfall for the territory.

events.narrative: A culvert failed leading to mud, water, and debris over State Route 23, at MP33 south of Lamont. The road was closed for clean up. No other reports of damage.

Scattered landslides reported around the Island. Motorists driving up the Fagasa Pass shared videos and pics of fallen trees and debris from mudslides blocking the road close to 4 pm. Villagers in Alofau also reported a landslide that blocked the west bound lane. Rainfall from the past 24 hours reported at WSO Pago Pago was 5.13 inches. ||Crews from Public Works and ASPA were at the scene clearing the road while cars in both directions waited.
